entries.title: About Life Changing Christian Church
entries.answer: Life Changing Christian Church (LCCC) — motto: 'We Are Life Changers' — is a Full Gospel Bible-believing church. Our mandate is to take the gospel of Jesus Christ to all people and to witness the visible manifestation of God's power to rescue and transform lives through salvation, prayer, holiness, deliverance, and sound biblical teaching.

entries.title: Church Founder and Leadership
entries.answer: Life Changing Christian Church was founded by Pastor Isaac Onwordi, who serves as the Senior Pastor of the ministry. Pastor Marcel Onwordi handles the design and layout for the church's extensive publications.

entries.title: Church Vision
entries.answer: The vision of LCCC is to rescue and transform lives through sound teaching of the Word of God, fasting, prayer, deliverance ministration, holiness, and a personal commitment to Jesus Christ — the eternal head of the church.

entries.title: Church Mission
entries.answer: LCCC seeks to evangelise the world through the life-changing power of God Almighty and to preach deliverance from captivity in order to set free those who are afflicted.

entries.title: Salvation and Becoming Born Again
entries.answer:
LCCC teaches that being born again is the most important step in your spiritual life. It involves:
1. Confessing your sins to God
2. Renouncing the devil and all his works
3. Accepting Jesus Christ as your Lord and Saviour

Would you like to pray the salvation prayer right now? Just ask and I'll guide you through it! 🙏

entries.title: Salvation Prayer
entries.answer:
We're so glad you want to receive Jesus! 🙏

Repeat this prayer sincerely:

"Almighty Father, I come to You in Jesus name, confessing my sins, renouncing the devil and his ways, and accepting Jesus Christ Your Son to be my Lord and Saviour. I believe with all my heart that Jesus died for my sins and was raised from the dead and now confess Him as my Lord and Saviour. I declare that I am born again. Amen!"

Confession after salvation:
"Father, now that I am reborn, graciously fill me with Your precious Holy Spirit and with fire so that I can faithfully serve Christ forever, in Jesus name. Amen!"

🎉 Welcome to God's family! Please contact the church so we can walk this journey with you: (+264) 061-309876 or lifechangers77@gmail.com
keywords: how do i pray for salvation

entries.title: Baptism
entries.answer: LCCC teaches biblical water baptism as an important and obedient step of faith after salvation. Baptism is an outward declaration of an inward transformation. The church provides ministry teachings and pastoral guidance for those who wish to be baptised. Contact the office to arrange your baptism.

entries.title: Church Services
entries.answer: Church services at LCCC include Miracle, Healing, and Deliverance services featuring sound biblical teaching, prayer, worship, and 'Testimony Time' — where members share accounts of divine intervention. Services are spiritually charged and focused on the visible power of God.

entries.title: Prayer for Healing
entries.answer:
Let us pray together. 🙏

"Heavenly Father, I come before You believing in Your healing power. Your Word declares in Psalm 103:3 that You heal all our diseases. I stand on Your promise. Let Your healing flow right now — spirit, soul, and body — in the name of Jesus.

Every messenger of sickness and death in my body, come out and die now. Blood of Jesus mix with Holy Ghost fire and purge me of all evil deposits. I shall not die but live to declare the works of the Lord. Amen."

Share your healing request with our prayer team on WhatsApp: https://wa.me/264817813918

entries.title: Prayer for Peace and Comfort
entries.answer:
You are not alone. Let us pray. 🙏

"Father God, I bring this burdened heart before You. Your Word says in Philippians 4:7 that Your peace surpasses all understanding. Quiet every storm in my mind and heart. Let Your peace guard my heart and mind through Christ Jesus. Amen."

Reach out to our prayer team anytime — we are here for you.

entries.title: Prayer for Deliverance
entries.answer:
If you are facing spiritual bondage, oppression, or any form of captivity, LCCC believes in the power of God to set you completely free. 🙏

"In the name of Jesus, I break every evil covenant and yoke of bondage upon my life. Every chain of oppression is broken by fire. Every power holding me captive, release me now. I declare that the blood of Jesus sets me completely free. Amen."

We strongly encourage you to connect with our deliverance team directly: (+264) 061-309876

entries.title: Struggling or Going Through Difficulty
entries.answer:
We hear you, and God sees every detail of what you're facing. 💛

Isaiah 41:10 says: 'Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God.'

You don't have to face this alone. Pastor Isaac teaches that stubborn problems are cases the enemy sponsors — but every chain can be broken through aggressive, faith-filled prayer. Our prayer team is ready to stand with you.

Send us a prayer request on WhatsApp: https://wa.me/264817813918 — or call us at (+264) 061-309876.

entries.title: Women's Ministry and Conferences
entries.answer: LCCC hosts Women's Conferences as part of its special ministry programs. These events are dedicated to empowering, encouraging, and spiritually equipping women in their faith walk. Contact the church office for information on upcoming women's events.

entries.title: Spiritual Warfare and Prayer
entries.answer: LCCC places a strong emphasis on spiritual warfare through midnight and early morning prayers. Pastor Isaac teaches in PowerShift that 'the kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power' (1 Corinthians 4:20). The believer must fight with knowledge, strategy, and aggressive faith to shift the balance of power from the oppressor to the oppressed.

entries.title: What is Power Shift?
entries.answer:
PowerShift is a ministry book by Pastor Isaac Onwordi that teaches how to provoke divine solutions to your problems through aggressive, knowledge-based spiritual warfare prayers. The book covers:
• Spiritual warfare terms and concepts
• Satanic devices and weapons
• Deliverance of your destiny and foundation
• Breaking difficult and prolonged situations
• Power over witchcraft, evil dreams, and evil dedications
• Prayers for healing and complete deliverance

Available at lcccstore.com.

entries.title: What is Prayers for Warriors?
entries.answer:
Prayers for Warriors is a powerful ministry book by Pastor Isaac Onwordi, written for believers who are tired of being defeated by the enemy. It teaches that a spiritual warrior must:
• Plan and prepare before engaging the enemy
• Put on the full armor of God (Ephesians 6:12-19)
• Target the strongman — the principal demon — not just junior spirits (Matthew 12:29)
• Pray to win and never accept defeat

The book contains over 50 targeted prayer sections including: Arresting Coven Powers, Breaking Collective Bondages, Deliverance of the Mind, Power Over Fear, General Deliverance, and much more. Available at lcccstore.com.

entries.title: What is the Bewitchment Book?
entries.answer:
Deliverance from Bewitchment, Spells and Charms is a book by Pastor Isaac Onwordi that exposes the reality of spiritual bewitchment. To be bewitched is to be disabled from God's will and purpose for your life — rendered incapable of fulfilling your destiny.

The book covers:
• How to handle charms and spells
• Bewitched behaviors, finances, marriage, and destiny
• Bewitched health and body parts
• Academic bewitchment
• Prayers for total deliverance in every area

Available at lcccstore.com.

entries.title: Foundational Problems and Bloodline Bondages
entries.answer:
Pastor Isaac Onwordi teaches in PowerShift that your foundation is your bloodline — your ancestors, the family you were born into, and the spiritual powers over the land of your birth. Signs of foundational bondage include: repeated family patterns of failure, poverty, broken marriages, or early death.

The good news is that through the blood of Jesus and targeted deliverance prayers, every foundational bondage can be broken. LCCC conducts specific deliverance programs for foundational issues.

Contact us at (+264) 061-309876.

entries.title: Breaking Stubborn and Prolonged Problems
entries.answer:
Pastor Isaac defines stubborn problems as troubles that will not go away — cases that mock your God and follow you year after year, supervised by a territorial or household strongman.

The strategy from PowerShift:
1. High-level, aggressive prayer and fasting
2. Targeting the strongman in charge (Matthew 12:29)
3. Sustained, consistent intercession — giving God no rest (Isaiah 62:6-7)
4. Seeking full deliverance ministration at LCCC

Contact the church: (+264) 061-309876.

entries.title: Bewitchment of Finances
entries.answer:
Pastor Isaac teaches in the Bewitchment book that financial bewitchment can manifest as: money that disappears without explanation, inability to hold money, reckless spending, poverty cycles, and dreams of losing money or having an empty purse.

Prayer for Financial Breakthrough:
"Every charm placed on my finances, catch fire and die in Jesus name. Every power wasting my money, die by fire in Jesus name. Every curse troubling my finances, be annulled by fire in Jesus name. Every embargo on my financial life, break and scatter now in Jesus name. Amen."

For targeted deliverance: (+264) 061-309876.

entries.title: Marital Bewitchment and Delayed Marriage
entries.answer:
Pastor Isaac Onwordi teaches that marital bewitchment can hinder people from marrying or cause marital crises. Signs include: unexplained rejection in relationships, repeated failed relationships, and inability to find or keep a spouse.

Prayer:
"Every evil covenant blocking my marriage, break and release me by fire in Jesus name. Every spirit of marital delay, your time is up, die now in Jesus name. I receive my divine marriage partner by fire in Jesus name. Amen."

For counseling and deliverance: (+264) 061-309876.

entries.title: Destiny Bewitchment and Limiting Powers
entries.answer:
Pastor Isaac teaches in PowerShift that limiting powers are evil spirits whose job is to frustrate every good thing in your life. God declares in Jeremiah 29:11: 'I know the plans I have for you — plans to prosper you and not to harm you.'

Signs of destiny bewitchment include: consistent failure despite effort, stagnation, the spirit of 'almost there' — getting close to breakthrough but never arriving.

Prayer: "Every limiting power assigned to frustrate my destiny, die by fire in Jesus name. I break free from every evil program against my purpose in Jesus name. My destiny is restored by the blood of Jesus. Amen."
keywords: failure at the point of success

entries.title: Coven Powers and Witchcraft Attacks
entries.answer:
Pastor Isaac Onwordi teaches in Prayers for Warriors that a coven is a secret stronghold of satanic powers where evil forces plan and execute attacks including failure, rejection, sickness, delayed marriage, poverty, and accidents. Coven powers include: witchcraft, occult powers, marine witchcraft, and household evil powers.

Prayer: "Every coven power assigned against my life, be arrested by fire in Jesus name. Every curse and spell issued against me from the coven, backfire now in Jesus name. I scatter every evil gathering against me by the fire of the Holy Ghost in Jesus name. Amen."

For full deliverance: (+264) 061-309876.

entries.title: Breaking Collective Bondages and Family Curses
entries.answer:
A collective bondage is an evil pattern that runs through a family or bloodline, sponsored by a shared curse or evil covenant. Pastor Isaac teaches that believers must refuse to suffer what others in their bloodline suffer.

Prayer: "Every evil covenant in my bloodline keeping me bound, break and release me by fire in Jesus name. Every evil pattern of my family pursuing me, break, die and release me forever in Jesus name. Father, instead of collective bondage, let me inherit Abraham's blessings in Jesus name. Amen."

Book: Prayers for Warriors — lcccstore.com

entries.title: Deliverance from Fear
entries.answer:
Pastor Isaac teaches in Prayers for Warriors that fear is a demonic spirit that must be confronted and expelled — not managed.

Prayer: "Every power hunting for me because of what I will become, die in Jesus name. Every fear of the unknown, be paralysed by fire in Jesus name. Arrows of fear and anxiety fired into my life, come out now by fire in Jesus name. Power of divine boldness, fall upon me now in Jesus name. I forcefully evict every fear from my life from today in Jesus name. Amen."

Scripture: 'For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.' — 2 Timothy 1:7

entries.title: Healing a Damaged Spirit
entries.answer:
Pastor Isaac teaches in PowerShift that every human being is a spirit, having a soul and living in a body. A healthy spirit is essential for spiritual growth, healing, and breakthrough. Your spirit can be crushed by habitual sin, sorrow, and an unforgiving heart.

Prayer: "Father, heal my damaged spirit. Restore my spirit-man to full strength. Let Your fire fall and revive every area of my spiritual life. I receive a sound and strong spirit in the name of Jesus. Amen."

Scripture: 'But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.' — 2 Peter 3:18

entries.title: How to Handle Troubling Dreams
entries.answer:
Pastor Isaac Onwordi teaches in PowerShift that dreams are spiritual means of communication. God uses dreams to reveal secrets and give warnings (Joel 2:28). But there are also evil dreams planted by the enemy.

Common warning dreams include: being attacked, eating in dreams, sexual dreams with unknown persons, seeing dead people, or being chased. These may signal spiritual attacks that need immediate prayer after waking.

Prayer after an evil dream: "Every evil program activated against me through this dream, be cancelled by the blood of Jesus. I reject every satanic message in that dream. Let it not manifest in my life in Jesus name. Amen."

For dream interpretation and deliverance: (+264) 061-309876.

entries.title: Academic Bewitchment and Prayer for Studies
entries.answer:
Pastor Isaac Onwordi teaches in the Bewitchment book that academic bewitchment attacks a person's ability to study, learn, and pass examinations. Signs include: forgetting what you study, failing despite preparation, and dreams of unfinished exams.

Prayer for Academic Breakthrough: "Every evil covenant and decree against my academic success, break and scatter in Jesus name. Curses blocking my studies, be annulled by fire in Jesus name. Powers of academic failure, die by fire in Jesus name. My brain is anointed for excellence in Jesus name. Amen."

Resources: Prayers for Warriors and PowerShift — lcccstore.com.

entries.title: Fasting and Prayer
entries.answer:
Pastor Isaac Onwordi teaches in PowerShift that fasting is very effective in dealing with difficult and prolonged situations. Jesus fasted before overcoming the enemy.

Principles of effective fasting:
1. Fasting must be done in righteousness and holiness (Isaiah 58)
2. Choose the kind of fast appropriate to your need
3. Combine fasting with targeted, aggressive prayer
4. Live a fasted Christian life as a lifestyle

Scripture: 'You who call on the LORD, give yourselves no rest, and give Him no rest...' — Isaiah 62:6-7

entries.title: Power Shift — What It Means
entries.answer: A Power Shift, as taught by Pastor Isaac Onwordi, is a divine switch of positions between the oppressed and the oppressor. Through salvation, prayer, fasting, and the blood of Jesus, the believer can provoke a divine shift that moves the power from the enemy's side to God's side — transforming every area of their life. This is the core message of LCCC's ministry.

entries.title: Fresh Fire of God Prayer
entries.answer:
A powerful prayer for those who need a fresh move of the Holy Spirit:

"Fresh fire of God that evil cannot withstand, fall upon me and my family in Jesus name. Fresh fire of God that brings great spiritual revival, fall upon my family and let there be an outburst of Holy Ghost revival in Jesus name. Fresh fire of God that will make evil flee from me, fall upon us now. God of fresh fire, arise and visit my life afresh today in Jesus name. Amen." 🔥
